description.value: Two Horns is an upscale Korean and Japanese BBQ steakhouse in Richmond specializing in premium cuts including dry-aged beef and Canadian Prime Beef. The restaurant emphasizes quality sourcing and tableside grilling, and has drawn attention as one of the few authentically run Korean BBQ spots in the Richmond area. A touring cyclist visiting the Richmond cycling network would find a full sit-down dining experience with lunch specials and delivery/online ordering available.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 63m; rack at 73m; rack (8 spaces) at 85m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The primary evidence source is the twohorns.ca website, which confirms an operating upscale Korean and Japanese BBQ steakhouse at 4231 Hazelbridge Way, Richmond, BC V6X 3L7, with phone (604)-214-1488. The website navigation includes 'Delivery' and 'Order' items, providing positive evidence of takeout/delivery service. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (604)-214-1488 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
OSM address omits postal code; website provides V6X 3L7, used as the fuller value.
Subpages /aboutus and /menu return 404 errors on the Azure Static Web Apps host; main page and core content load correctly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with active website, customer reviews, and confirmed address. A useful food stop for touring cyclists in Richmond.

wow_evidence: one of the few authentically run Korean BBQ spots in the Richmond area
